footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Outdoor Holding: includes $1.4M from discontinued operations; after $3.1M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Mar 31, 2026 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 3.5% to $51.1M in fiscal 2026 (ended Mar 31, 2026). Gross margin was 87.2%, versus 86.9% a year earlier, and the operating loss narrowed to $6.3M from $59.7M.
The net loss narrowed to $6.6M, or −$0.05 per share, from $134M. Operating cash flow was $964K and free cash flow −$1.9M, versus −$8.5M; Outdoor Holding returned $314K through buybacks.
sources: Outdoor Holding Company Form 10-K for FY2026 (SEC EDGAR)
